journeys.name: Glance at the book
journeys.goal: Is my book safe right now, and how fresh are these numbers?
steps: Open RollCall on the phone
Read the account line and freshness stamp at the top
Read Net liq and the risk strip
Read Drop to call and its grade
Scroll for cash, buying power and carry

keep.what: Drop to call gives the book's safety as one number, a grade and a plain sentence in the first view

evidence.text: The whole book can fall 77.2% before your broker asks for more margin.

journeys.name: Handle what needs me today
journeys.goal: What do I have to do today, and can I do it from here?
steps: Open Actions from the tab bar or the overview
Read the Needs attention list, urgent card first
Read the suggested trade and its numbers on a card
Act on it, or mark it Done, Snooze or Dismiss

keep.what: The urgent roll is marked Do today and sits at the top of the Actions first view

journeys.name: Roll a call from the ladder
journeys.goal: Let me see every strike I could roll into and pick one myself.
steps: Open the urgent card on Actions
Press Roll this — or choose another call
Read the ladder for the chosen expiry
Pick a strike and read what the roll pays or costs
Review the ticket before sending

keep.what: The ticket opens the whole ladder, every expiry and strike, and says the pick is the trader's own

evidence.text: Any listed call, including off-rule choices; the ticket prices both legs together.

journeys.name: Check one position
journeys.goal: Where does this holding stand and what should I do with it?
steps: Open Positions
Scan the list, attention rows first
Open one position
Read the suggestion and why
Go back to Positions

keep.what: Each position row carries a plain sentence saying what to do and why

evidence.text: TSLA is 7.8% past your strike, so roll up to the Fri Dec 11 $330 call and collect $350.

journeys.name: Open a new covered call
journeys.goal: Find a stock and sell a covered call on it.
steps: Open Trade
Choose Screener or Browse
Run the screen or look up a ticker
Open the ticket and see the price before sending

keep.what: Trade tells the trader the market is shut and that a price is shown before anything is sent

evidence.text: The market is shut, and every price below is the last one quoted before the close.

journeys.name: Check my orders
journeys.goal: What did RollCall send, and is anything still working?
steps: Open Orders
Read whether anything is working
Read finished orders
Cancel a working order if needed

keep.what: Orders says up front whether anything is working

journeys.name: Review how the book has done
journeys.goal: How much has this book made me over time?
steps: Open Analysis from the tab bar
Read the value history headline
Change the period
Read what each name has banked

keep.what: The period is spelled out with deposits taken out, in plain words

journeys.name: Read alert history
journeys.goal: What has RollCall told me lately?
steps: Press the bell
Read unread alerts grouped by day
Open the related action
Mark all read

keep.what: Alerts are grouped by day, each with a button to the trade, and the page says which actions were never pushed

evidence.text: 4 open actions were never pushed to you — see why in Actions.

journeys.name: Connect and set up
journeys.goal: Connect my broker and set my rules.
steps: Log in the first time
Open Settings
Pick the broker and add keys
Set trading, brakes and rules

keep.what: Settings sections are named in a row at the top, and the real-money state is stated in plain words

journeys.name: Check that RollCall is running
journeys.goal: Is RollCall scanning and alerting as it should?
steps: Open System
Read the last action and scan time
Read the audit list

keep.what: The health line says when the last scan ran and that the audit chain checks out

problems.claim: The pinned risk strip under the top bar scrolls sideways on most screens: on overview-390-normal it holds 1215 px of content in a 390 px box, so Buying power, Margin excess, Leverage and Net carry sit off to the side of Net liq. On overview-390-partial the broker explanations inside it stretch it to 3155 px.

At 320 px the page is wider than the screen on 23 of 26 captures: overview-320-normal lays out at 372 px and settings-320-normal at 436 px. At 390 px it is wider on 6 of 26, including overview-390-first-login and orders-390-error.

The overview's attention list, the things that need the trader now, starts 3.3 screens down at 390 px and 4.8 at 320 px. With an urgent roll, the overview first view still opens on Drop to call and the list sits 3.3 screens down (4.6 at 320). On desktop it starts 1.6 screens down.

Pages lay everything open at once. The overview has 11 open blocks and is 5.7 screens tall at 390 px (8.6 at 320), with the grading rules and the model's figures spelled out and a long account explanation under Net liquidating value. Position detail has 7 open blocks, alerts 6, and analysis runs 4.7 screens tall.
Settings is one page 26.9 screens tall at 390 px (38.2 at 320), with 292 tap targets under 24 px. It lays out at 436 px, wider than either phone.

Text is small on every capture. Overview-390-normal has 34 runs under 12 px, 25 sentence runs under 16 px, a smallest size of 10 px and 11 distinct sizes. Analysis-390-normal goes down to 9 px across 14 sizes.

Tap targets under 24 px appear on 25 of 26 captures at 390 px. Counts: 34 on overview-390-normal, 20 on actions-390-normal (where Snooze and Dismiss sit), 20 on roll-ticket-390-urgent, 38 on positions-390-normal and 114 on system-390-normal.
The phone tab bar is two rows, 93 px tall, on every capture, and holds every screen from Positions to System. Alerts is not among its tabs.

The freshness stamp in the top bar is clipped on every phone capture. On overview-390-normal 'As of Thu, Nov 5, 2:21 AM PT' shows 22 of 175 px, while the page tells the trader to press that date. On the empty book the stale warning 'As of Fri, Sep 18 close · 48 days ago' shows 20 of 207 px.

value: fresh neutral: clipped, shows 22 of 175 px ("As of Thu, Nov 5, 2:21 AM PT")
fresh amber: clipped, shows 20 of 207 px ("As of Fri, Sep 18 close · 48 days ago")

problems.claim: Data tables in the page scroll sideways on phones: positions with 661 px in a 364 px box, analysis with 912 px in a 316 px box, the system audit with 935 px in a 364 px box, and the settings rules with 998 px in a 314 px box.
The roll ticket's ladder body scrolls sideways: 821 px of content in a 356 px box at 390 px, and in a 354 px box at 320. Part of each strike row the trader picks from sits off the side.

The urgent card and the ticket explain the stuck roll in rule jargon. The card says only that nothing is to be done inside the rules, and the ticket says every priced strike was refused, without saying in plain words what the trader can do.

evidence.text: CRCL is past your roll rules: no strike still profitable if called pays a credit, so nothing to do inside them.

problems.claim: While the overview loads, the sentence about data freshness shows a dash for the date, and the top stamp 'Loading…' is itself clipped. The attention list starts 2.2 screens down.
When the alert history fails to load, the Alerts page shows the same list as normal and no error message, so the trader is not told the history may be incomplete.

A new trader's first login shows the same screen as an empty connected book, including the 48-days-ago stamp. It has no welcome and no first step beyond finding a position; the connect-your-broker line sits far down in the page.

evidence.text: Nothing on the book yet — when you open a position it will show here.
As of Fri, Sep 18 close · 48 days ago

problems.claim: The top bar has no product name or page title. It holds the account label, a clipped stamp and unlabeled symbols; the page title appears only below the risk strip.
A SIMULATED badge sits in the account line on every screen, and the practice-account paragraph repeats on the overview and analysis.
The Analysis headline labels its figure as portfolio value, but the big number is the period's loss, $733.69, shown with a down arrow next to that label.
The phone Positions screen shows keyboard shortcut hints that a touch user cannot use.
On System, audit summaries are cut by ellipsis: 41 truncated runs, each cut short of its full line.
Orders opens on practice-broker explanations before the order list. In the error state, the same reason is stated three times before the fix.

notes: R9 (desktop premium-at-stake side panel) has no capture that shows the panel, so it is not assessed. R3's 'Quick version' and R8's 'More' do not exist on the captured screens: today every screen is in a two-row tab bar (P8) and there is no More. Alerts is reached from the bell in the top bar. All captures are QA sample or practice books, so the SIMULATED label is accurate here; R5 concerns real accounts. page_errors is 0 everywhere. No capture shows an error message without an action.
